title: Board cards show No Charge in place of the amount
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, in status Approved, billable, so a card with an amount can be compared.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1's card shows "No Charge" where work order 2's card shows its amount.
  • Work order 1's card shows the "Internal" badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R4: “Lines on an internal or no-charge work order show quantity, cost (parts) and hours (labor) and no sell prices: the Rate, Margin and Total columns of the lines table (a part's sell price sits in Rate) and the Sell price, Rate and Margin fields of the line and part dialogs are hidden and not required; there is no work order total, tax, fee or discount block; the shop supplies block is the flat amount of Story 10. Cost is shown only to users with 'See Financial Data', as cost is today; other users see quantity and hours. The estimate and invoice documents for these work orders show the same and carry the NO CHARGE stamp and, on a no-charge work order, the line "Category: [Category]" under the stamp; the shop-floor Print Work Order is unchanged (it carries no prices today). Board cards and the statistics that show a work order total show "No Charge" in place of the amount.”
  • S2-R10: “The work orders list shows the badge in the status column for internal and no-charge work orders in every tab, in the Tech View display and on the mobile card. Open and closed internal and no-charge rows show "No Charge" in Total Price (the column exists only for users with 'See Financial Data'; others see the badge); closed ones show where invoiced ones show (the All tab, Status "Closed"), not in the Completed tab, which lists work waiting for an invoice. Board cards show the badge, and a closed internal or no-charge work order sits where an invoiced one sits on the Board. Schedule cards show the badge next to the work order number (the card shows no status text); global search results show it next to the status. The Status chip on the All tab gets the value "Closed", which matches only closed internal and no-charge work orders; Invoiced and Paid do not match them. The customer's and the asset's Work Orders tabs show the same badge.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: boards "03 Work order · in progress" (page "Flow 1 · Create and close"), "14 In progress: cost and hours, no prices" (page "Happy flow v6"), "07 Finance tab · open estimate" (page "Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order"), "10 Board · internal card" (page "Flow 4 · Find internal and no-charge work orders"). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.
